description:
Use this when the user wants a video or clip found by a word in its name: "find my tournament stream". Up to
20 matches; fetch takes an id for details.
Not for: what is said in a video (find_moments) or the web. Free and read only.

query.description: Words from a project name or clip title, 1-512 characters; every word must match
